_note: Seal patterns (bible §7). beats = ms after the first beat; a ring closes on the seal for leadMs before each beat. Windows are ±ms around a beat, widened as the target weakens. Fire/Water/Plant/Spark are the first four (PLAN M3); other types use the default until they get their own. Tune in play-testing.

windows._window: [at full HP, at 0 HP]; linear in between
